title: Chronic venous insufficiency
summary: Chronic venous insufficiency of a lower extremity with extensive brawny edema or superficial varicosities, stasis dermatitis, and recurrent or persistent ulceration not healing after 3 months of prescribed treatment.

children.criterion: Chronic venous insufficiency of a lower extremity with deep venous thrombosis, valvular incompetence, or post-thrombotic syndrome

Extensive brawny edema involving at least two-thirds of the leg between ankle and knee, OR superficial varicosities, stasis dermatitis, AND recurrent or persistent ulceration that has not healed after at least 3 months of prescribed treatment
